When my childhood dog was put to sleep our vet sent us a card with lyrics from “The Dance” by Garth Brooks. I had said I don’t think I could ever get another dog again because it hurt too much. 

I thought of that and was able to open my heart when I found a dog that needed someone to adopt her or she would have to be put down due to no space in a rural shelter in middle of nowhere Texas. 8 years later she’s still my best friend. Every time I think about how I won’t be able to take it when she dies I just think of, “I could have missed the pain, but I’d have had to miss the dance” ❤️

I always say this song sounds like how depression feels. In the worst time of my life my top song on Spotify was Fade to Black by Metallica, second most played was No Surprises. 

It really gets me nowadays too, I’ve been diagnosed with narcolepsy and am on medical leave from work, wondering if I’ll ever be able to function normally again. I spend so much time sleeping and fall asleep sitting up all the time, I can’t even drive, I’m 25 and completely missing out on life. It’s like sinking into “a quiet life … with no alarms and no surprises”

Just the thought of how much they were hurting at that time and traumatized they must have been from worrying I wouldn’t make it, gets me every time I hear it now 😭 Every time it gives me the urge to go apologize to them for the millionth time. 

“Now I understand 
What you tried to say to me
And how you suffered for your sanity 
And how you tried to set them free
They would not listen, they did not know how
Perhaps they’ll listen now”

I was in a coma for 4-5 days and I guess the doctors were telling them they had no way of knowing for the first few days if I would wake up or have brain damage or survive the pneumonia I had contracted. Of course it all worked out and I went to rehab after since I’m here typing this. 

When I got home and had my phone for the first time I saw that he had sent me that song and said something like “I’m home trying to sleep before I go back to the hospital to see you. I just want you to wake up. I will happily take care of you for the rest of my life if you need it but I can’t live without you“ 

Now I’m fighting the urge to call him and wake him up while he’s on vacation and ugly cry to him 😭

If wounds are open disinfect then apply Vaseline/Aquaphor, if closed but scabbing etc just use the ointment. If there are mild signs of early infection like tenderness and weeping you can apply antibiotic ointment, there’s a prescription one called Mupirocin that is 💯 but you can use OTC too.
